_note: VRF-3b (owner 2026-11-05 11:30-14:56, boards 12-15): hvac_vrf list_spec.pricing.extras and the 29 HVAC Pricing Inputs the extras read -- ONE single-factor input per table cell (a band's input id is the PREFIX: <id>_supply_mm / _return_mm / _insulation_mm; a cable's <id>_cores / _sqmm), so the grid, the panel and the CSV carry them with no new column. The v59 mint (scripts/_instruments/mint_hvac_v59_vrf3b.py) writes exactly these; test_vrf_v59 proves the asset equals this file (item_uid aside).
